short.text: Eugene Monroe has proven he is an NFL starting left tackle. He was Jacksonville's left tackle for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games in 2013, re-signed for five years in March 2014, was named an offensive captain and has started {{2014.regular.line_starts:words}} games in 2014. Pass protection is his best contribution: he sets and mirrors well, has a sound punch, recovers after losing leverage and has enough anchor against power. As a run blocker he is solid rather than dominant, both driving defenders off the ball and working up to the second level.
